_meta.role: Forward Deployed Engineer + Robotics & Embedded Systems Engineer (combined)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY building the embedded hardware, software and integration layer that edge AI robotics runs on. Deployed a vision-guided robotic system end to end on NVIDIA Jetson, STM32 and Arduino: C++, Python, bare-metal C firmware, Linux systemd services and networking across 3 devices, 5.2× TensorRT speedup, and 11 integration failures debugged across software, sensors, power and network. Comfortable with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and EAGLE PCB design.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment; used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative analysis.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration on a headless Jetson.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system over a three-layer pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller on a unified WebSocket fabric.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override; used FreeRTOS mutexes for task coordination and VL53L0X ToF sensing.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.

Programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1 and I2C1 in bare-metal C with timer-triggered ADC scans, interrupt-driven capture and a low-level I2C driver; 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz; verified in Proteus.
